text:
maya: Quick planning ping — I want to carve out a 30–45m design review for the new unified client config API + Console rollout flags. Looking at Wed/Thu next week. Pre-read and checklist below, pls RSVP and call out any blockers.

sam: Wed or Thu both work for me. prefer mornings PST. 30m okay. :+1:

oliver: can we aim for 40m? need time for API surface + ux walkthrough. who are the required reviewers?

ashley: I can cover security review. please include the migration plan in the pre-read. PR + mocks here: https://git.redwood.dev/r/unified-config (mock links in the PR)

jordan: timezone check — if we do Wed 10:00am PST that’s 19:00 CET for me, still ok. any other EMEA folks should chime in.

maya: Proposed slots (pick one):
- Wed 10:00–10:45am PST (18:00–18:45 CET)
- Thu 9:30–10:15am PST (17:30–18:15 CET)

Pre-read checklist (please complete before the meeting):
- [ ] Read API spec (POST /v1/client-configs) in the PR
- [ ] Review Console mock flows (link in PR)
- [ ] Migration plan summary (1 paragraph)
- [ ] Perf/latency targets + batching notes
- [ ] Security/privacy callouts (ashley to add)
- [ ] Quick risk/regression checklist for canary

Suggested agenda (40m):
```
1) 5m - goals & success criteria
2) 15m - API contract walkthrough + edge cases
3) 10m - Console UX walkthrough (flows + states)
4) 5m - rollout/migration plan + monitoring
5) 5m - Q&A / action items
```

maya: If you have slides or a 1-page summary, drop into the PR as a PDF. also pls add any specific eval prompts we should run post-rollout.

sam: RSVP: Wed 10:00 PST works for me. I'll prep a short diff summary.

ashley: I'll add security/privacy bullets to the checklist by EOD today. also request to include threat-model notes in PR description.

leo: i'm OOO Wed morning, can do Thu slot. if Wed chosen, can I join for the last 20m?

maya: ok notes: ashley adds security, sam will prep diff summary, leo can join late if we pick Wed. final call: can people +1 their preferred slot?

jordan: +1 Wed 10:00 PST

sam: +1 Wed

leo: +1 Thu (but can join Wed late)

oliver: +1 Wed (prefer Wed for full attendance)

calendar-bot: Tentative event created: "Design review — unified client config" Wed 10:00–10:45am PST. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood/j/123456789. Invite sent to reviewers list.

maya: Thanks — I’ll lock Wed 10:00 PST if no objections by EOD. Please add any docs to the PR thread. Recording will be captured and posted.

jordan: Thanks, i'll review pre-read tonight.

sam: noted — i'll add a short 'backwards-incompatible changes' note to the PR.

ashley: added security checklist and threat-model link to PR.

maya: Closing the loop: Wed 10:00 PST confirmed. Action owners: maya (agenda & recording), sam (diff summary), ashley (security + threat model), oliver (ux walkthrough), leo (canary plan draft). See PR for materials.

leo: thanks — i'll aim to have canary plan up by Tue EOD.

calendar-bot: Event pinned to channel. Recording will be available under the event after the meeting."
